parsed.rationale: All four participating records reside in 'Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift', a test file in the Artwork package. Although the pipeline has flagged is_test=false on each record (likely a tagging gap — the file path unambiguously places these methods inside a Tests/ directory under test-suite class names such as iTunesArtworkServiceTests, LastFMArtworkServiceTests, and DiscogsArtworkServiceTests), the structural context is clearly a test fixture. Each SequentialMockSession.data method is a mock helper scoped to its enclosing test class; consolidating them would couple unrelated test suites and obscure per-service test intent. The duplication is intentional fixture repetition, not production code divergence.
